title: From Generation to Scoring: Scaling LLM-Based Semantic Labeling at LinkedIn
abstract: arXiv:2610.36383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For efficiency, industrial large language model (LLM) labelers often pack many candidate labels into one prompt and generate a YES/NO answer for each, even when each decision depends only on the entity and one candidate. Generating these independent decisions as one answer list couples them, spends decoding on the list, and relies on the list being well-formed. In this paper, we present an end-to-end recipe that reformulates the labeler as semantic scoring, fine-tuning it on single-candidate prompts to return each decision as one answer-token score from a prefill-only pass. We also adapt Multiple-Item Scoring (MIS) to score hundreds of candidates in one sequence with attention masked between them. Deployed for profile qualification labeling at LinkedIn, semantic scoring changes at most 0.01% of decisions when candidates are reordered and matches the agreement with reference labels that packed generation reaches only with about 4.7x as

translated_title: 从生成到评分：在LinkedIn扩展基于大语言模型的语义标注
translated_abstract: 出于效率考虑，工业界的大型语言模型（LLM）标注器通常将多个候选标签打包到同一个提示中，并为每个候选生成一个是/否的答案，即使每个决策仅取决于实体和单个候选标签。将这些相互独立的决策作为一个答案列表生成会使它们相互耦合，把解码计算花费在列表上，并依赖列表格式的正确性。本文提出了一种端到端的方案，将标注器重新构建为语义评分，通过在单候选提示上进行微调，使其在仅预填充过程中将每个决策返回为一个答案token分数。我们还改进了多项评分方法，在一个序列中对数百个候选进行评分，并在候选之间屏蔽注意力。该方法已部署于LinkedIn的个人资料资格标注任务，当候选顺序被打乱时，语义评分最多仅改变0.01%的决策，其与参考标签的一致性达到打包生成方法需要约4.7倍计算量才能实现的水平。
tldr: 该论文提出将基于大语言模型的语义标注从生成式答案列表重构为语义评分方法，通过单候选提示微调和多项评分技术，在LinkedIn的实际部署中实现了更高效、更稳健且对候选顺序不敏感的标注方案。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates LLM-based semantic labeling from list generation to per-candidate token scoring, using single-candidate prompt fine-tuning and Multiple-Item Scoring (MIS) to achieve more efficient and order-robust labeling at LinkedIn.
